description:
Fixes for Sync for Reddit v23.06.30-13:39, free and Pro, after Reddit blocked /api/info and /api/morechildren in October 2026.

- **Fix Reddit galleries**: galleries open again.
- **Fix load more comments**: "View more" works again.

v1.1.0 adds Sync Pro (com.laurencedawson.reddit_sync.pro). Nothing changes for the free version: no need to repatch it.
